items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: He had a big tone. He was pretty strong, he had a big tone.

ctx.x: Was he smooth or rough or did he, big tone or what was he?
He had a big tone. He was pretty strong, he had a big tone. He played, he was a kid punch clarinet.
Oh that's right, yeah. Did you ever play with punch too or any time?
